extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Mutual of Omaha plan available in Lee County has a $40 monthly premium, a $180 drug deductible and a $6400 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent discussed plan benefits before the disclaimer, which is non-compliant. The agent collected the Scope of Appointment and scheduled an appointment, which is compliant.
composition.coaching_note: Owen, it's important to deliver the disclaimer before discussing any benefits to ensure compliance. In this call, the disclaimer was given after the agent started discussing plan details. Next time, make sure to deliver the disclaimer first.

crm_record.next_step: Review and sign Scope of Appointment
